entries.what: Got home from the Sunday night overtime shift on the cold dock at 7:30 a.m., ate eggs and rice, and crashed.
entries.outcome: Slept until about 1:30 p.m., cut a bit short by hallway noise.

entries.what: Went to the 2-5:15 p.m. Monday section at Bayshore State and copied Fatima's shared notes afterward.
entries.outcome: Caught up on the lecture he half missed.

entries.what: Packed a container of chicken and rice, then carpooled to Ridgeline with Trevor for the 9 p.m. shift.
entries.outcome: Clocked in on time and got his dock assignment.

entries.what: Finished the night shift on the cold dock, then slept after breakfast.
entries.outcome: Got a solid stretch of sleep because he had no class on Tuesday.

entries.what: Did laundry at the apartment and chatted with Arjun about the week while eating a late lunch.
entries.outcome: Easy conversation, no advice given.

entries.what: Carpooled out with Trevor for another overtime night at Ridgeline.
entries.outcome: Another ten-hour night started.

entries.what: Came off shift at 7:30 a.m., slept a few hours, and got up for his midday stats tutoring session at the Bayshore center.
entries.outcome: Worked through practice problems to keep the C+ climbing.

entries.what: Sat through the Wednesday afternoon section, then texted the assistant for help with a sincere message to Jade after a rough week of missed time; he asked for it to be less corny.
entries.outcome: Sent a toned-down, sincere text to Jade.

entries.what: Rode with Trevor to Ridgeline for the night shift.
entries.outcome: Started shift without incident.

entries.what: Slept through the morning after the shift, then went to the Thursday 2-5:15 section.
entries.outcome: Fatima's notes covered the part he nodded through.

entries.what: Quick dinner at home, then carpooled to Ridgeline for the Thursday night shift.
entries.outcome: Last full weeknight of the week on the cold dock.

entries.what: Finished the shift at 7:30 a.m. on payday, then lifted at Iron Flats Fitness for his Friday session.
entries.outcome: Got the session in before sleeping.

entries.what: Slept in the afternoon and sent the biweekly mom fund transfer after getting paid.
entries.outcome: Transfer sent to his mom.

entries.what: Had a free Friday night with no shift, hung out at the apartment with Arjun and played video games.
entries.outcome: Got a rare night of normal sleep.

entries.what: Hit the gym again early, then picked up a few things for the week.
entries.outcome: Second lift of the week done.

entries.what: Passed the Thanksgiving food drive crowds near Our Lady of the Marsh on the way home and thought about his mac and cheese for his mom's table.
entries.outcome: Made a mental list for the groceries.

entries.what: Saturday evening date with Jade at Phở Bến Thành.
entries.outcome: Dinner went well and the tension eased.

entries.what: Did the Sunday chicken-and-rice meal prep, five containers.
entries.outcome: Food set for the week.

entries.what: Napped in the afternoon to prepare for the night, then carpooled with Trevor to Ridgeline for the Sunday 9 p.m. shift, the last day of mandatory overtime.
entries.outcome: Started the final overtime night.

entries.what: Worked the cold dock with a freezer jacket and counted down the hours to the end of the overtime run.
entries.outcome: Made rate without a write-up.
